description:
Frontend Developer 
 
 Job Summary 
The Front-End/UI-UX Developer is responsible for translating business requirements into intuitive, responsive, and visually compelling user experiences. This role focuses on UI/UX design, front-end development, dashboard and report design, and collaborating with business stakeholders to create user-centric applications that improve usability, accessibility, and engagement.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and develop modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications using Angular, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, and related front-end technologies.
 Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business processes into intuitive user interfaces, wireframes, prototypes, and user experiences.
 Lead UI/UX design efforts, ensuring consistency, accessibility, usability, and adherence to enterprise design standards and best practices.
 Create and maintain reusable UI components, design systems, and front-end frameworks to improve development efficiency and user experience consistency.
 Design, develop, and enhance Tableau dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide meaningful business insights and support data-driven decision-making.
 Partner with backend developers, architects, and business teams to ensure seamless integration between user interfaces, APIs, and enterprise systems.
 Conduct usability testing, user research, and continuous user experience improvements based on stakeholder feedback and analytics.
 Stay current with emerging UI/UX, visualization, and front-end development trends and recommend innovative approaches to improve user engagement and application adoption.
 
 Qualifications 
 Proven experience (5+ years preferred) designing and developing enterprise web applications with strong expertise in Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.
 Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and intuitive user experiences.
 Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, accessibility standards, user-centered design methodologies, and front-end best practices.
 Hands-on experience designing and developing Tableau dashboards, reports, visualizations, and data-driven user interfaces.
 Experience working with REST APIs and integrating front-end applications with backend services and enterprise systems.
 Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar platforms.
 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating effectively with business stakeholders, developers, and cross-functional teams.
 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience implementing AI-powered user experiences, conversational interfaces, or AI-assisted analytics and reporting solutions.
 Experience modernizing legacy user interfaces and participating in cloud-based application migration initiatives.
 Familiarity with enterprise design systems, component libraries, and data visualization best practices.
 Relevant certifications in UI/UX Design, Tableau, Front-End Development, or related disciplines are highly desirable.
 
 
 
 
 Remarkable benefits: 
 •    Health coverage for medical, dental, vision 
 •    401(K) saving plans with company match AND Pension     
 •    Tuition assistance 
 •    Floating holidays and PTO for community volunteer programs 
 •    Paid parental leave 
 •    Wellness programs 
 •    Employee discounts (membership, insurance, 
 travel, entertainment, services and more!)
